axes.model_access: The main line is Zhipu's self-developed GLM series (Zhipu's official site zhipuai.cn has a model-release line); the GLM open-weight line (HF/ModelScope) and the cloud chat are the same family — running locally belongs to the runner dossiers. In-app model tiers are per the signed-in UI.
axes.runtime: Web (chatglm.cn) + iOS/Android apps; generation is processed on the vendor's cloud, no model runs locally. The developer entry is the open platform (open.bigmodel.cn) — same vendor, two interfaces alongside the chat product.
axes.local_files: Chat history and knowledge-base files are stored on the account side; the product has a "knowledge base" surface (upload documents for retrieval Q&A), data lives in the cloud account.
axes.background: Chats return instantly; the product includes agent and browser-extension entries (seen in official navigation); no official statement verified for an "offline continuation" form.
axes.tools: In-product capability lines incl. data analysis (code-interpreter type), text-to-image, web retrieval and PPT generation (seen in the official feature-page navigation); an agent-creation surface exists. MCP support not verified item by item.
axes.context: Session history syncs when signed in; the knowledge base is an explicit cross-session material surface; finer memory mechanics not verified item by item.
axes.permissions: Account system (phone-number registration); the training-use switch path not verified item by item. The GLM model filing number is in the cn block (cross-verified against official public disclosures).
axes.fit: Suits: Chinese long-document parsing and retrieval Q&A, wanting the GLM open-weight same family (run locally if the cloud isn't enough), student/workplace document scenarios. Does not suit: office/social ecosystem integration, or fully leaving the account system.

runs:
